definitions.explanation: A three-month period, especially in business and financial contexts. One fourth of a year.

examples.japanese: {第|だい}1{四半期|しはんき}の{売|う}り{上|あ}げは{好調|こうちょう}だった。
examples.english: Sales in the first quarter were strong.

examples.japanese: {四半期|しはんき}ごとに{決算|けっさん}{報告|ほうこく}を{行|おこな}う。
examples.english: We issue financial reports every quarter.

examples.japanese: {次|つぎ}の{四半期|しはんき}は{新|あたら}しいプロジェクトに{集中|しゅうちゅう}する{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: We plan to focus on a new project in the next quarter.

notes:
BUSINESS USAGE:
In Japan, the fiscal year typically runs from April to March:
- {第|だい}1{四半期|しはんき} (Q1): April-June
- {第|だい}2{四半期|しはんき} (Q2): July-September
- {第|だい}3{四半期|しはんき} (Q3): October-December
- {第|だい}4{四半期|しはんき} (Q4): January-March

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {四半期|しはんき}{決算|けっさん} (quarterly financial results)
- {四半期|しはんき}{報告|ほうこく} (quarterly report)
- {四半期|しはんき}ごと (quarterly, every quarter)
